# Band: MODX, walking bass, outputs, phrases, arp, arranger

(Moved from the root CLAUDE.md 2026-11-27.)

- The band through a Yamaha MODX (Web MIDI out, routing, compare page `gear/modx-band.qmd`): `apps/shared/band/modx.js`, NOTES.org "MODX" round.
- MODX percussion auditions (`gear/modx-perc.qmd`, `apps/shared/band/modx-perc.js`: loops for Pop Latin Kit ch 9, Real Brushes 10, Jazz Brushes 11, Brush Kit 12, and rock / pop / R&B / hip-hop on four test slots (ch 13-16, any of 32 kits in `modx-kits.js`); key maps from the MODX+ Data List in ~/Documents/Manuals; each pattern's `checked` names its sources (`scripts/sources/modx-perc.py`); ☆ picks, kit walk). Sampling the MODX into one software kit (licence: personal use only, never on the site): `research_notes/modx-sampling.md`. Tests `node tests/band/modx/modx-perc.test.js` (`NEG=1` must fail), `tests/band/modx/modx-perc.cdp.js`.
- Walking Bass Generator (`tools/walking-bass.qmd`, `apps/shared/band/walking-bass-page.js`, global WalkingBass): presets or typed changes, key, choruses; plain walk / devices / two-feel with bass.js WALKING DEVICES sliders, seeded; drawn in bass clef (triplets `(3`, ghosts `!style=x!`, notes coloured by device), `checkAbc` reads lengths and pitches back; plays via AbcPlay (`bandOpts.bassLine`, style swing, melody off). Hand-off `bandHandoff` `from:"walking-bass"` (mode exact = every chorus written out + `opts.bassLine`, dropped by `clearWalkLine` on key / changes edits; devices = `opts.walkDevices`), Backing Track vars `wbDev` / `wbLine` in menuOpts. Test `node tests/band/walking-bass.cdp.js` (after `quarto render tools`; `NEG=1` must fail).
- The band out to a mixing desk (one channel per instrument, e.g. X32 over USB): `BandPlayer.output` in `apps/shared/band/player.js` (search "output routing"), panel `output-panel.js` under Mixer → Outputs on the Backing Track. Test `PORT=<port> node tests/band/bt/outputs.cdp.js` (headless has 2 channels, so the many-channel path is only checked with the desk connected).
- Phrases (one stored pattern with per-note velocity that plays and is drawn as ABC; used by the workstation arp and the Style Arranger): `apps/shared/band/phrase.js` (format in its header), test `node tests/band/phrase.test.js`
- Workstation-style arpeggiator (MODX/Montage-like: phrase arp types, 4 parts, key modes, key/velocity ranges, scenes, notation per part): `apps/shared/motif-arp.js` on `tools/sequencers.qmd` (plugs in through `SeqPage.kit`; what is checked against Yamaha and what is not is in its header, sources in `scripts/sources/arpeggiators.py`). Tests `node tests/seq/motif-arp.test.js`, `tests/seq/sequencers.cdp.js` (`SITE=<dir>` tests a render made elsewhere)
- Style Arranger (`tools/arranger.qmd`, after Yamaha PSR/Genos styles: 8 channels, Intro/Main A–D/Fill In/Break/Ending, chord recognition, NTR/NTT conversion from CM7, RTR): rules in `apps/shared/band/style-engine.js` (header says which are from the Genos and PSR-I610 manuals and which are this site's reading), styles in `apps/shared/band/arranger-styles.js` (written over CM7 per Yamaha's recording rules, grid shorthand in its header), page `apps/shared/arranger-page.js`. Tests `node tests/band/style-engine.test.js`, `node tests/band/arranger-styles.test.js`, `tests/arranger/arranger.cdp.js`
